Innovation
Built From Scratch
01
CFO Assistant
Founder & Developer · Digital Finance Tool

A proprietary digital platform that automates financial reporting, KPI dashboards, and variance alerts. Enables managers to make real-time financial decisions without waiting for manual reports. Modules cover cash flow forecasting, cost variance alerts, and live profitability tracking. Available on request.

02
Profitability Gate Model
Internal Control Framework · Adopted Company-wide

A structured pre-execution approval model requiring every new project to achieve a minimum 40% gross margin. Adopted company-wide. Directly contributed to growing operating profit from 36% to 47%.

03
Finance Dept. — Zero to One
Organizational Build · Internal Controls

Built Rhythm's entire finance department from the ground up with minimal resources: policies, systems, internal controls, reporting structure, and a team of 8. Established the first reliable financial foundation the company had ever operated on.

04
Monthly Close System
Process Design · Reporting Speed

Designed a standardized monthly close process that consistently delivers full financial statements within 4–10 business days — enabling leadership to act on fresh data instead of aged reports.
